meta.name: brand-agency
meta.description: Applies Agency brand colors and typography to artifacts including presentations, SVG graphics, documents, and web interfaces. This skill should be used when brand colors, visual formatting, neobrutalism style, or Agency design standards apply. Keywords - branding, corporate identity, visual identity, styling, brand colors, typography, visual formatting, visual design, neobrutalism.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为演示文稿、SVG、文档和网页应用品牌配色与字体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速将品牌色和字体应用到各类设计输出中
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to presentations, SVGs, documents, and web interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand colors and fonts across design outputs

howto.what: Claude 会使用 Agency 品牌的配色、字体和粗野主义风格（粗边框、硬阴影、无圆角）来生成演示文稿、SVG 图形、网页和文档。
howto.when: 当你要求制作品牌相关的内容，或提到“品牌色”、“视觉风格”、“粗野主义”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 用 Agency 品牌风格做一张标题幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会生成橙色背景、黑色粗边框的幻灯片。

say.text: 帮我画一个 SVG 圆形图标，用品牌橙色。
say.note: Claude 会应用品牌色和硬阴影。

say.text: 给这段 HTML 加上 Agency 的样式。
say.note: Claude 会添加 CSS 变量和粗野主义样式。

howto.what_en: Claude will apply Agency brand colors, typography, and neobrutalism style (bold borders, hard shadows, no rounded corners) to presentations, SVG graphics, web pages, and documents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for brand-related content or mention keywords like 'brand colors', 'visual style', or 'neobrutalism'.

say_en.text: Create a title slide in Agency brand style.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an orange slide with black thick borders.

say_en.text: Draw an SVG circle icon using the brand orange.
say_en.note: Claude will apply brand colors and hard shadows.

say_en.text: Style this HTML with Agency's design.
say_en.note: Claude will add CSS variables and neobrutalism styles.
